description: The file contains comments and shell commands intended to verify the existence of specific firewall rules and chains using nftables or iptables on an OpenWrt system. It documents procedures for checking firewall ruleset presence via command line, including fallback mechanisms.
calls: R "nft list ruleset 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'chain input|chain forward|chain output' | sed 's/[[:space:]]\+/ /g' | sort | uniq || true"
